sources.title: Delaware County Official Results: 2024 Primary Election (Clarity, data version 338133)
Republican preview ballot, Morton Borough, May 19, 2026 (no county committee contest)
2026 Primary write-in cumulative results (only Democratic county committee and Republican state committee contests appear)

notes: Delaware County Republicans did not elect county committee in the May 19, 2026 primary: the 2026 Republican ballot and results list only state committee. The most recent Republican committee election found is the April 23, 2024 primary, with one Committeeman and one Committeewoman contest (Vote for 1) per precinct across 428 precincts. Filled = a ballot candidate won with more votes than all write-ins combined. Empty = no ballot candidate and zero write-in votes. Unknown = write-in votes only, since the county publishes only "Unassigned write-ins" and no write-in winners list was found (408 seats), plus one seat where the ballot candidate did not exceed the write-in total. The source has two contests labelled "Committeewoman, Chadds Ford Township" with no precinct; both are filled, so they are assigned to the Northeastern and Southwestern precincts in source order without affecting the count. Precinct names are the 2024 names. The county reported 383 precincts in 2026, so precincts have since been consolidated and these 428 may not match current precinct names. Vacancies filled by appointment after 2024 are not captured.
